title: Sources: CISA's Attack Surface Evaluation team is using Mythos to audit government code repositories and has already uncovered a large number of vulnerabilities (Raphael Satter/Reuters)
summary: Raphael Satter / Reuters: Sources: CISA's Attack Surface Evaluation team is using Mythos to audit government code repositories and has already uncovered a large number of vulnerabilities — The U.S. cyber defense agency CISA is using Anthropic's AI model Mythos to audit government software, three people familiar …
